decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (2711-01/MT, dated 06/13, received 24/07/13; 2711-02/MT, dated 06/13, received 24/07/13; and 2711-03/MT, dated 06/13, received 24/07/13) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side or rear walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the outbuilding without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as No. 53 Sutton Square, Hounslow and shall not be used for primary residential accommodation, for business use, or as a separate dwelling.
description: Erection of a detached single storey outbuilding for use as a gym and store room to the rear of the house.
